apis.name: Census Bureau API
apis.why_notable: Primary US demographic, economic, and ACS data API; free key; core for population and socioeconomic analysis.

apis.name: data.gov Catalog API
apis.why_notable: US federal open-data catalog (CKAN); discovery layer for thousands of government datasets.

apis.name: Federal Register API
apis.why_notable: Official US Federal Register documents, rules, and notices as structured JSON.

apis.name: GovInfo API
apis.why_notable: GPO access to bills, statutes, CFR, Congressional Record, and official publications.

apis.name: FBI Crime Data Explorer API
apis.why_notable: US crime statistics (UCR/NIBRS) from FBI Crime Data Explorer for research and apps.

apis.name: USGS Earthquake Hazards API
apis.why_notable: Real-time and historical earthquake feeds (FDSN Event Web Service); no key required.

apis.name: NWS API
apis.why_notable: National Weather Service forecasts, alerts, and observations; free with User-Agent.

apis.name: NASA Open APIs
apis.why_notable: Government space/Earth science APIs (imagery, NEOs, Mars, etc.); free demo key.

apis.name: World Bank Open Data API
apis.why_notable: Country development indicators and statistics used worldwide for research and apps.

apis.name: Eurostat API
apis.why_notable: EU official statistics (JSON-stat/SDMX); core source for European socioeconomic data.

apis.name: ONS API
apis.why_notable: UK Office for National Statistics datasets: economy, population, labour market.

apis.name: INSEE API
apis.why_notable: French national statistics and business register (SIRENE); free self-serve keys.

apis.name: Destatis GENESIS API
apis.why_notable: German Federal Statistical Office GENESIS web service for official statistics.

apis.name: data.gov.au CKAN API
apis.why_notable: Australian federal open-data portal CKAN API for dataset discovery and resources.

apis.name: data.gov.sg API
apis.why_notable: Singapore government open data: transport, environment, economy; developer-friendly.

apis.name: SF Open Data API
apis.why_notable: San Francisco Socrata open data; widely used city portal for civic apps.

apis.name: LA Open Data API
apis.why_notable: City of Los Angeles open data (Socrata); crime, permits, budget, services.

apis.name: Seattle Open Data API
apis.why_notable: Seattle city open data portal via Socrata SODA API.

apis.name: data.police.uk API
apis.why_notable: UK street-level crime, outcomes, and neighbourhood policing data; free, no key.

apis.name: legislation.gov.uk API
apis.why_notable: UK primary and secondary legislation as structured data (Akoma Ntoso/XML).

apis.name: OpenSecrets CRP API
apis.why_notable: US campaign finance and lobbying data (Center for Responsive Politics); free key.

apis.name: ProPublica Congress API
apis.why_notable: Legislative votes, members, bills; popular third-party Congress data layer.

apis.name: UN Comtrade API
apis.why_notable: UN international trade statistics; free tier with registration for global trade data.

apis.name: IMF Data API
apis.why_notable: IMF macroeconomic and financial statistics (IFS, WEO, etc.) via SDMX/API.

apis.name: OECD Data API
apis.why_notable: OECD country statistics and indicators via SDMX REST API; free access.
